name: Strong Input Buffer
description: Configurable early jump and orb input buffer. Saves short taps that happen just before a landing or orb. Supports both player icons and resets safely.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Turn buffered jump rescue on or off. Original inputs always pass through to GD.

window-ms.name: Buffer Strength (milliseconds)
window-ms.description: How long an early tap is remembered. 40 ms = mild, 100 ms = strong, 160-250 ms = very strong. Large values can fire jumps you didn't intend.

orb-buffer.name: Buffer Orbs / Rings
orb-buffer.description: Replay an early released tap when an orb becomes touchable, as well as on a landing.
